bio_en: Sargis Barseghian, known by many noms de guerre - Shamil, Kolot (short) Sargis and Vana Sargis - was born in 1875 in Getak village in the Ganja district and, as a boy, longed to enlist as a volunteer. A former student, he joined the ARF, which 're-baptised' him, and became one of its most selfless figures in Vaspurakan. In 1904 he spoke to the band before the 'Razi' border fight, and in 1906 he sat on the ARF Vaspurakan Central Committee with Aram, Vana Ishkhan and Salman. At the 4th General Congress (1907) he argued that self-defence should be organised in the compact Armenian areas that could become sources of a future general movement; he died in 1915.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Quote #31 is his (4th General Congress speech). Years 1875-1915 from the title; circumstances of death not read.
